name: dev-flow
description: AI agent first development process. A single `dev-flow` skill drives the four-phase flow (1. Planning bundle: ADR + Requirements + Design + Spec in one batch when ADR is settled; ADR-only if Open Questions remain -> 2. Test -> Implementation -> 3. Documentation -> 4. Done) by delegating each phase to dedicated subagents (`dev-flow-<name>` under `~/.cursor/agents/`). Auditor subagents auto-invoke at phase boundaries. The `dev-flow` skill uses `disable-model-invocation: true` as the explicit prompt entry point.
